subject: Admit CivitAI as an optional native Model Manager discovery and staged acquisition provider
decisions: CivitAI is discovery/metadata/acquisition source only and does not become artifact trust, Model Registry, secrets, routing or placement authority.
The FA3 GUI exposes a native CivitAI catalog and may also expose the website inside Qt WebEngine; external browser is not the default.
Public catalog browsing may operate anonymously when upstream allows it.
Authenticated operations obtain the credential through FA3-SECRET-BROKER-001 and use Authorization: Bearer; query-string tokens and DOM injection are forbidden.
Selected files require upstream SHA-256 before staged acquisition; mismatch blocks import.
CivitAI pickle/virus scan fields are attributed provider metadata and never substitute for FA3 Model Artifact Security admission.
License/usage terms, provenance, lineage and runtime compatibility must be resolved before production promotion.
